text:
incidents-bot: P1: Customers reporting duplicate billing lines for short embedding batches and occasional repeated vectors. Opening incident and posting live status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2133333333-duplicate-embed-lines

tara-sre: Observed duplicate metering events with identical event_hash and timestamp cluster. Spike started ~2133333200. Dup rate small (~0.4%) but affects high-volume micro-batches.

owen-telemetry: Rolling check shows producer retries from ingress pool with identical message ids. Hypothesis: backpressure + aggressive retry debounce in ingress SDK v4.0. Enabling ingress-side dedupe flag and rolling back SDK to v3.9.2 for canary clients. ETA ~10m.

maria-billing: Holding invoice generation for the affected window and preparing a soft credit for suspected duplicates. Billing hold ref: BH-2133333333. We'll coordinate with support for outbound comms.

anya-support: Draft status note pinned in #support-ops: "We're investigating duplicated billing entries for some embedding requests. We've paused billing for the impacted window and will apply credits where duplicates are confirmed. Status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2133333333-duplicate-embed-lines" Please review.

tara-sre: Mitigations in flight:
- 2133333345: toggled ingress dedupe feature-flag for micro-batch clients
- 2133333420: canary rollback of SDK on high-volume clients started
- queued backfill dedupe job (job id dedupe-2133333333) to run after rollback

owen-telemetry: Canary shows duplicate event count down ~90% on canary hosts at 2133333670. Rolling changes to remaining ingress nodes.

maria-billing: Finance will generate a preliminary affected-account list and soft-credit amounts in ~30m. We'll post the reconcile link to the status page.

anya-support: Support copy (quick):
"Thanks — we detected duplicated billing lines for some embedding calls and have paused billing for the impacted window. We're running an automatic reconcile and will credit affected accounts. If you see duplicate vectors in responses, please include request IDs and sample payloads. Status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2133333333-duplicate-embed-lines"

status-bot: Status page updated. Next update scheduled in 20 minutes or on significant changes.

tara-sre: Timeline so far:
- 2133333200: first synthetic alerts for duplicate metering
- 2133333333: incident created and runbook triggered
- 2133333345: ingress dedupe flag enabled
- 2133333420: SDK rollback started
- 2133333670: canary success metrics observed

maria-billing: If duplicates persist after 2133334100 escalate to finance on-call. Postmortem and reconciliation report will be attached to the status page once complete.
